The Grubhub Merchant Data API provides endpoints for managing merchant information, including store details, tax rates, fulfillment settings, and configuration groups. Partners can retrieve all Grubhub locations associated with a merchant's account, update merchant profiles, and manage operational settings such as online/offline status. This API is essential for maintaining accurate restaurant data across the Grubhub platform.
